title: What the novelty in c58's 3-component waste vortices is: the population's trait centroid makes a persistent (superdiffusive) walk ~10x faster in MSD than in the kind-blind twin, while the share of classes that survive 1000 t is the same in both arms (~0.24 vs 0.27-0.48) and the cloud stays within ~1 trait unit of the ancestor
summary: Re-analysis (novelty2.py) of c58's six trait3d runs (seeds 1-2 to T=6000, seed 3 to T=10000, kind-specific waste vs kind-blind twin). Classes (cells of side dm=0.4) whose activity reaches 5 vortex-samples: 51/53/76 against 28/25/40; per 1000 t the selective arm keeps finding 3-13 (seed 3: 10,6,6,9,12,3,8,4,13,5) while the twin falls to 0-3. The mechanism signature is in the population trait centroid: its MSD at lag 1000 t is 0.08-0.14 against 0.010-0.012 in the twin, at lag 4000 0.32-0.59 against 0.02-0.04, with a log-log slope ~1.3 over lags 300-3000 (persistent, running from its own 500-t waste) against ~0.9 in the twin; standing diversity (mean pairwise trait distance) is 0.71-0.80 against 0.36-0.40, flat after t~3000. Turnover is not higher: of the classes that had reached activity 5 by t-1000, 0.23-0.24 are still present at t in the selective arm and 0.27-0.48 in the twin, and the mean class age of the vortices present keeps growing in both arms (5600 vs 9300 at t=10000, seed 3), because the cloud recrosses old cells.

finding.operator: kind-specific waste with a 500-t memory on a 3-component trait
finding.control: kind-blind waste twin (sw 0, same draws), c58's seeds 1-3
finding.result: centroid MSD(1000 t) 0.08-0.14 vs 0.010-0.012, slope ~1.3 vs ~0.9; diversity 0.71-0.80 vs 0.36-0.40; classes reaching activity 5: 51/53/76 vs 28/25/40; 1000-t class survival 0.23-0.24 vs 0.27-0.48

limits: Re-analysis of existing runs only (3 seeds sharing mut_seed 1, so the mutation directions are the same sequence on every seed; fresh-seed runs with their own mut_seed are under way). The trait space is unbounded, isotropic and featureless: a 3-D random walk is transient (Polya) and visits new cells at a rate that does not saturate even under neutrality, so 'classes ever held' cannot by itself separate open-ended from neutral; only the excess over the identical-draw twin (a Bedau-Packard neutral shadow) carries information, and that excess is a larger rate constant from a faster, persistent walk of the whole cloud, not a higher replacement rate of classes. New classes are new labels relative to the waste, not new phenotypes. Smoothed curves use a 9-sample window.
